statusDetail: Cloudflare managed challenge prevented access to the target site. This is a reconnaissance-only partial run, not a completed audit.

page.notes: The target application could not be profiled because Chrome received a Cloudflare “Just a moment…” Turnstile challenge document.

artifacts.caption: Desktop viewport after navigation: Cloudflare managed challenge instead of FetLife.
Rendered challenge DOM showing “Just a moment…”, /cdn-cgi/challenge-platform, and Turnstile.
Recon probe: challenge title, no target links, forms, or body text.
robots.txt was readable, but sitemap.xml was itself replaced by a Cloudflare challenge.

checkOutcomes.method: Attempted direct navigation and recon with raw-CDP screenshot, DOM capture, and evaluate probes at https://fetlife.com; inspection stopped when the external anti-bot challenge prevented target access.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The rendered document title was “Just a moment…”, its HTML loaded /cdn-cgi/challenge-platform and a challenges.cloudflare.com Turnstile script, body text and target links/forms were absent, and the screenshot captured only the challenge surface.
checkOutcomes.reason: A Cloudflare managed challenge (Turnstile, page title “Just a moment…”) replaced the target page in a fresh headless Chrome session. It exposed no target navigation, content, forms, or representative interaction, so this check could not be judged against FetLife itself.
